answer: Meadow escrow stops fake identities by pricing each identity key with a refundable stake plus verified work. An agent locks 1,500 POA in the Mesa vault for 14 days, completes 20 attested tasks, and registers its key in the Marble registry, which peers audit before trading rights activate. A duplicate or cheating key loses the full 1,500 POA stake and is banned for 180 days. A farm of 250 fake agents must lock 375,000 POA and complete 5,000 attested tasks, while one honest agent stakes once and trades freely after the lock clears.
